findings.claim: No test binds the production wiring: nothing proves formatGroundingRefusal receives the count the Found: line printed, so the fold's whole purpose is unpinned.
findings.counterexample: All four new tests call the formatter directly with a literal (spec.test.ts:1103,1121,1131,1142); the only command-level tests reaching line 995 (spec.test.ts:1867 and :1874) seed zero lessons, so replacing context.lessons.length with a literal 0 keeps all 4521 cli tests green. The harness already keys by typeFilter (spec.test.ts:86), so seeding { lesson: [makeLesson()] } would pin it in four lines.

findings.claim: The changeset asserts an exhaustive user-visible delta that fold 3 falsified: it says the ONLY user-visible difference is the non-empty Found line, while the diff adds two new sentences to a refusal a user reads.
findings.counterexample: Line 24 reads 'The only user-visible difference is that the Found: ... N lessons line, and the prompt section behind it, are no longer empty on an index that holds lessons'; spec.ts:749 and spec.ts:752 add new user-facing text, and fold 3 did not touch the changeset.

findings.claim: The new clause test builds its verdict from two lessons and then passes ten as the delivered count, constructing a state production cannot produce.
findings.counterexample: spec.test.ts:1116 seeds lessons: [makeLesson(), makeLesson()] while spec.test.ts:1121 calls formatGroundingRefusal(..., FLOOR, 10); in production the two numbers are the same value by construction at spec.ts:995.

findings.claim: The test titled 'byte for byte' asserts containment, not message equality, though the stronger toBe form is used thirteen lines later.
findings.counterexample: spec.test.ts:1132-1134 is toContain plus two not.toContain, so an added third line in the zero-lesson arm passes; spec.test.ts:1144 uses toBe. The repo's own totem lint flags spec.test.ts:1123, 1124, 1132 and 1145 with 'use exact string assertions (e.g., toBe or toEqual) to ensure surrounding context is preserved'.

findings.claim: The published refusal documentation shows only the pre-fold arm and no test enforces the doc against the code.
findings.counterexample: cli-reference.md:399 renders 'Retrieval returned 0 hits - nothing in the index grounds this run.' with no lesson arm; grep for 'cli-reference' across packages, tools and scripts returns only legs.test.ts files, so no docs-parity test covers the spec refusal.

findings.claim: The new failure-mode row narrates in the past tense a run no committed artifact records, on a state whose reachability is never established.
findings.counterexample: The row says a run 'printed Found: ... 10 lessons'; hits === 0 requires zero spec, session_log and code rows (spec.ts:688-690) beside lesson rows, sync.ts exposes no per-type scope flag producing that store, and the commit message's live line is an ISSUE-anchored run that never reaches the gate at spec.ts:992.

findings.claim: The F3-fork bullet mis-states its own position in the record, and the commit message repeats the error.
findings.counterexample: The bullet at line 163 says 'after the four questions above were answered', but Question 1 is at line 154, Question 2 at 157, Question 3 at 160 and Question 4 at line 165 - below it; only three questions are above. The commit body repeats 'without rewriting the four questions that preceded it'.

findings.claim: The ruling's supporting parenthetical is selective: it cites mmnto-ai/totem#2700's silence on partitions while omitting that same document's all-items refusal key.
findings.counterexample: .totem/specs/2700.md:274 states the key as 'retrieval returns 0 items' and :309 as '0 items refuses (the charter's rule)' - partition-agnostic all-items language that under fold 1 no longer describes the firing state (10 items retrieved, 0 grounding hits reported). The parenthetical's two cited facts do verify at 2700.md:3 and 2700.md:241.

findings.claim: The new clause renders ungrammatically for a single lesson.
findings.counterexample: spec.ts:752 templates '${deliveredLessons} lesson(s) were retrieved', so deliveredLessons === 1 prints '1 lesson(s) were retrieved'.

verdict: Fold 3 holds mechanically: the fourth parameter has exactly one production caller (spec.ts:995), the zero-lesson text is byte-identical to 31e4f8b4 including the U+2014 em dash, the below-floor arm is provably untouched, the JSDoc is accurate against 19e08f56 (which did read 'over ALL items across the four partitions' and did sum four), the refusal text reaches no machine reader (tools/pre-commit reads the artifact, and a refusal mints none), formatGroundingRefusal is not on the package's public surface, the record's table still parses and is prettier-clean, and every reported gate reproduces exactly (cli 172/4521/20, core 151/4290/5, tsc 0, prettier clean, eslint 0 errors, totem lint PASS 0 errors) - but the fold's central coupling is untested (F1: a literal 0 at the call site keeps the suite green) and the changeset still claims the non-empty Found line is the ONLY user-visible difference (F2), so the seat should rule on those two plus the three record-wording defects before presenting for merge.
